tagline: A media player planned around voice-led search and playback.
summary: Media player project centred on voice control, playback and a modular media experience. 1145Hz Player is the public name of the project previously referred to as LSI Player.
statusNote: 1145Hz Player is being built. No download has been published yet.

audiences.name: Listeners and viewers
audiences.description: People who want to play their own audio and video and find it quickly, including by voice.

capabilities.name: Voice-led search and playback
capabilities.description: Find and control media by speaking.
capabilities.platformNote: Voice features may not be offered on every platform. Each release will state where they work.

capabilities.name: Playback
capabilities.description: Play audio and video with standard transport controls. Supported formats will be confirmed by engineering before release.

capabilities.name: Library management
capabilities.description: Add folders of media and browse them as a library.

capabilities.name: Modular design
capabilities.description: The player is being developed as separate modules so that features can be added over time.

requirements.label: Operating systems
requirements.detail: Not confirmed yet. Supported operating systems will be listed with the first release.

requirements.label: Permissions
requirements.detail: Voice control will need microphone access on platforms where it is offered. Access to the folders you add to your library will also be needed.

platformNote: Features can differ between platforms. Voice control is only promised on platforms where a release says it is implemented.
gettingStarted: There is nothing to install yet. Installation, first-run setup and library setup steps will be published with the first release.
limitations: No release exists, so nothing described on this page can be used yet.
Supported platforms, formats and voice features are not confirmed.
